<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex081012026-10-1503-30-09" status="unreviewed"> dngos gzhi rnam par dag pa'i mi shun phyogs ni dang gi gses ba snang yang ste sred pad dng ra pa dang lta ba dang ma dg pa khas cle ba dzas rim pa bzhin no <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4291">brang ti</rs> zer ro ||
 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">lo</rs> na re 'di dag ni <lb n="55b5"/> dmigs pa la seMs mi gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa ni ngo bo nyid kyis g.yeng ba dang phyi rol gyis g.yeng ba'o |
gnas kyang ma mthar mi gnas par 'gyur ba'i dbang du byas pa ni nang gi g.yeng bcod |
 mi gnas kyang gnas pa'i dbang du byas pa ni mtshan ma'i g.yeng pa'o | 
gnas pa skyon chags pa'i dbang du byas pa ni gnas ngan len gyi g.yeng ba dang yid la byed pa'i g.yeng ba yin te nang dang phyi rol la skyon chags pa rim pa bzhin no zer ro || </seg></TEI>
